name: ADJUDICATION_AMOUNT_TYPE

name: ADJUDICATION_TYPE
description: This is a code used to identify uniquely the type of adjudication.  Examples: - Internal - COB (Coordination of Benefits)

name: ASSET_INSURABLE_INTEREST
description: This entity contains those insurable interests that are party assets such as automobile, real estate, and inventory.

name: CLAIM
description: A claim is the request to the insurance company to honor the terms and conditions of one or more coverages included in one or more policies. description: This entity contains the history of the status of the claim for each claimant for this insurable interest.  Examples would be open, closed, settled, reopened, settled again, and closed again.

name: CLAIMANT_INSURABLE_INTEREST_STATUS_TYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the status of the claim to each claimant. Examples would be open, closed, settled, reopened, settled again, and closed again.

name: CLAIM_ADJUDICATION
description: A decision on the settlement of a claim.

name: CLAIM_ADJUDICATION_AMOUNT
description: This associative entity relates adjudications done at the claim level to the claim adjudication. For this combination, the adjudicated amount is included.  Examples include amounts at claim level such as: - Paid amount - Allowed amount - Approved amount

name: CLAIM_AMOUNT
description: This associative entity relates the claim with the amounts for the claim, such as the total claimed amount, lawyer fees, and claims adjuster fees.

name: CLAIM_AMOUNT_TYPE
description: This minor entity contains the claim amount types and descriptions that can be associated with a claim or a claim service. name: CLAIM_ASSET
description: This entity demonstrates which assets were involved with the claim.

name: CLAIM_ASSET_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE
description: This is the code for the type of association between the claim and the asset, such as the object of the claim, or the replacement asset while the damaged asset is being repaired.

name: CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION
description: This entity describes the authorizations that have been granted for insurance purposes. This includes admission review, claim service review, and specialty care reviews.

name: CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_AMOUNT
description: This entity associates authorized amounts with the claim authorization. These are for amounts at the authorization level.

description: This minor entity contains the claim authorization amount codes and descriptions that can be associated with a claim authorization. Examples include requested length of stay amount, requested minimum amount, and approved number of units.

name: CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_ATTACHMENT
description: This entity relates the attachments associated with the claim authorization.

name: CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_CATEGORY
description: A category for the type of claim authorization requested.  Examples: - Admission review - Claim services review - Specialty care review (referral)

name: CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_CERTIFICATION
description: These are the certifications related to the claim authorization.

name: CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_DIAGNOSIS_CODE
description: This entity identifies the diagnostic code(s) associated with a claim authorization.

name: CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_END_REASON_TYPE
description: The code for the reason that this authorization terminated such as maximum number of treatments exceeded or maximum amount exceeded.

name: CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_IDENTIFIER
description: This entity provides trace numbers assigned to the claim authorization as specified by a party.

name: CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_REASON
description: The reason for a prior authorization request. description: This associative entity relates one claim authorization to another.

name: CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the type of relationship between two claim authorizations such as one authorization replaces another, or that one authorization is a subsequent authorization.

name: CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_SERVICE
description: This entity identifies those procedures as requested on the authorization.  For health, one authorization can be representative of up to 11 procedures involved with the authorization.

name: CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_SERVICE_AMOUNT
description: This entity associates authorized amounts with the claim services on the claim authorization. For amounts at the authorization level. See entity CLAIM AUTHORIZATION AMOUNT.

name: CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_SERVICE_ROLE
description: Defines the role a service can have in relation to the authorization.  Examples: - Requested on - Relevant to  In health care, for example, the authorization may be because of a surgery procedure.

name: CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_STATUS
description: This entity provides the information of the status for a given claim authorization.  Examples include: - Delayed - Rejected - Approved

name: CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_STATUS_REASON
description: This minor entity identifies the reason for a claim authorization status type.  Example: For a CLAIM AUTHORIZATION STATUS TYPE of delay, the following reasons may exist: - Proof of eligibility unknown or unavailable - Delay in certifying provider - Delay in eligibility determination

name: CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_STATUS_TYPE
description: This minor entity translates the claim authorization status type code into a description.  Examples include: - Delayed - Rejected - Approved

name: CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the kind of authorizations.  Examples: - Renewal - Initial - Appeal – immediate - Appeal – standard - Revised

name: CLAIM_CATEGORY_TYPE
description: A high-level categorization of a claim based on type of claim, service codes, and diagnosis codes.

name: CLAIM_CLAIM_GROUP
description: An associative entity that relates the claims to the claim groupings that they belong to. There is one instance for each claim/claim grouping occurrence.

name: CLAIM_CLASS_SCHEME_TYPE

description: This code represents the classification value for a given classification scheme type. For example, if the classification scheme is "weather condition" then the values may be clear, cloudy, raining, snowing, heavy fog. Each value is one instance in this entity.

name: CLAIM_CLASS_VALUE_XREF
description: This entity relates the claim to the classification scheme code value. For example, if the classification scheme is weather condition at time of accident then the value could be heavy fog.

name: CLAIM_CLIA
description: This entity relates the claim to Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendment (CLIA) numbers.  This is required on Medicare and Medicaid claims for any laboratory performing tests covered by the CLIA Act.

name: CLAIM_COST_RECOVERY
description: This entity contains information about the recovery of costs for this claim such as recovery due to subrogation legal action.

name: CLAIM_COVERAGE
description: This entity associates claims with coverages.  A claim may be associated with one or more of the coverage features that are associated by the insurance account.  A coverage feature may be associated with one or more claims.  For example, this relates the claim to the property damage coverage, bodily

name: CLAIM_COVERAGE_ADJUDICATION
description: This entity relates the adjudication to the coverage involved in the adjudication.

name: CLAIM_COVERAGE_ADJUDICATION_AMOUNT
description: This entity describes the various amounts that were adjudicated for this claim for this coverage.  Examples: - Noncovered amount - Paid amount - Copaid amount - Deductible amount - Withheld amount - Allowed amount - Discount amount - Per day limit amount - Tax amount

name: CLAIM_COVERAGE_AMOUNT
description: This associative entity relates the claim coverage with the amounts for the claim coverage, such as the claimed amount, the consumed amount, or subrogation amount.

name: CLAIM_COVERAGE_COST_RECOVERY
description: This entity contains information about the recovery of costs for this claim coverage such as recovery due to subrogation legal action.

name: CLAIM_COVERAGE_INSURABLE_INTEREST
description: This entity links the claim with the coverage and the insurable interest.

name: CLAIM_COVERAGE_INSURABLE_INTEREST_AMOUNT
description: This entity contains the various amounts associated with a claim for an insurable interest and for a coverage. Examples of amounts include the amount of the claim, the amount that has been paid, the amount under dispute, and the amount being reserved.

name: CLAIM_COVERAGE_INSURABLE_INTEREST_REINSURANCE
description: This entity creates the association between claims, coverages being claimed, the insurable interest involved in the claim coverage and the reinsurance agreement that covers this claim coverage for this insurable interest.

name: CLAIM_COVERAGE_LEGAL_ACTION
description: This entity relates legal actions to claim coverages and allows a coverage for a claim to have many legal actions against it.

name: CLAIM_COVERAGE_SCORE
description: This entity contains scores related to claims on coverages such as probability of eligibility for subrogation of bodily injury coverage.

name: CLAIM_COVERAGE_STATUS
description: This entity tracks the status of a coverage for a claim over time such as "paid," "not paid," and "in process."

name: CLAIM_COVERAGE_TEXT
description: This entity captures any textual information related to the claim coverage such as notes prepared by an agent or adjustor.

name: CLAIM_COVERAGE_TEXT_SECTION
description: This entity is the link to claim coverage text unstructured data.

name: CLAIM_DATE
description: This entity relates claims to the various claim dates.  Examples: - Claim receipt date - Claim settled date - Claim occurred date - Last worked date - Returned to work date - Unable to work date - Schedule to return to work date - Unable to work start date - Unable to work end date

name: CLAIM_DATE_TYPE
description: This entity identifies the claim date types.  Examples: - Occurred date - Settled date - Receipt date - Reported date - Documented date - Last changed date - Unable to work start date - Unable to work end date

name: CLAIM_DIAGNOSIS_CODE
description: Identifies the diagnosis code(s) that are associated with a claim at the header level. This might be relevant for bodily injury claims.

name: CLAIM_DOCUMENT
description: Associates the claim with the related attachments. These can include documents such as radiology films, physical therapy certifications, or death certificates.

name: CLAIM_FILING_TYPE
description: Indicates the type of claim adjudicated or the expected claim adjudication process. description: This entity contains intended actions for follow up on a claim, such as sending a replacement vehicle or assessing the damage. The actual actions are instances of EVENT.

name: CLAIM_FOLLOW-UP_TYPE
description: This minor entity converts the claim follow-up type code into a description.

name: CLAIM_FREQUENCY_TYPE
description: This entity specifies the frequency values for a claim. name: CLAIM_GROUP_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes how claims are grouped. Examples of groupings can be diagnosis codes, incident, claim status, and services claimed.

name: CLAIM_INSURABLE_INTEREST
description: This entity is the damaged item for which a claim is being sought. If the damage is physical property then the insurable interest is the asset. description: This entity associates the damaged item (insurable interest) with the types of accidents that caused the damage. For example, an accident type could be house burned down or car side impact.

name: CLAIM_INSURABLE_INTEREST_TYPE
description: A category discriminator that classifies the type of insurable interest for this claim. It could be an asset such as automobile, or house, or a life.

name: CLAIM_LEGAL_ACTION
description: This entity tracks legal actions against this claim.

name: CLAIM_MANAGEMENT_AUTHORITY_TYPE

name: CLAIM_MEDIA_TYPE
description: The code for the type of medium sent via a channel such as disk, network, or paper.

name: CLAIM_MOTOR_VEHICLE
description: This entity represents the information that is specific to the motor vehicle in relation to the claim.

name: CLAIM_OBLIGATION_TYPE
description: This minor entity classifies the types of claim obligations, for example, ECO (Extra Contractual Obligations), XPL (Excess of Policy Limits), no ECO, or no XPL.

description: Identifies the kinds of perils (cause of loss) associated with the claim. Property is insured in two main ways - open perils and named perils. description: A type of claim referral.  Examples: - Surgery - Consultation - Treatment - Diagnostic testing

description: The amount associated with the reinsurance of this claim for this coverage for this insurable interest. name: CLAIM_RELATED
description: This entity defines the relationship between claims such as replaces.

name: CLAIM_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE

name: CLAIM_SCORE
description: This entity contains scores related to claims such as probability of eligibility for subrogation.

name: CLAIM_SERVICE
description: This entity associates claims with services or procedure features. This is the lowest level of detail on a claim. description: This is a code for the action that is being taken or will be taken by a party involved with this service for this claim. Examples include approve quote, perform service, or do not perform service.

name: CLAIM_SERVICE_ADJUDICATION
description: This entity relates the adjudication to the service involved in the adjudication.

name: CLAIM_SERVICE_ADJUDICATION_AMOUNT
description: This entity describes the various amounts that were adjudicated for this claim for this specific service.  Example: - Noncovered amount - Paid amount - Copaid amount - Deductible amount - Withheld amount - Allowed amount - Discount amount - Per day limit amount - Tax amount

name: CLAIM_SERVICE_AMOUNT

name: CLAIM_SERVICE_ASSET
description: The associative entity that links claim services to assets.

name: CLAIM_SERVICE_COST_RECOVERY
description: This entity contains information about the recovery of costs for this claim service such as recovery due to subrogation legal action.

description: This associative entity relates the service or procedure reported on the claim to the coverage that is associated with this service or procedure. description: This entity captures metrics for a service for a coverage for a claim such as the reserve amount or claim amounts paid. name: CLAIM_SERVICE_DATE
description: This entity relates the claim service to the various claim service dates.  Examples: - Settlement date - Recorded date - Shipped date

name: CLAIM_SERVICE_DATE_TYPE
description: This entity identifies the claim service date types.  Examples: - Settlement date - Paid date - Recorded date - Shipped date

name: CLAIM_SERVICE_DIAGNOSIS_CODE
description: This entity contains the relationship of diagnosis codes to a service line on a claim. Multiple diagnosis codes can be specified along with their ordering such as primary, secondary, or tertiary.

name: CLAIM_SERVICE_LEGAL_ACTION
description: This entity relates legal actions against a claim service and allows a service for a claim to have many legal actions against it.

name: CLAIM_SERVICE_REQUEST
description: This entity tracks service requests assigned to a claim.

name: CLAIM_SERVICE_SCORE
description: This entity contains scores related to services for claims such as probability of eligibility for subrogation of auto bodywork service.

name: CLAIM_SERVICE_STATUS_REASON_TYPE
description: This minor entity translates the claim service status reason type code into a description.  Examples: - Insufficient coverage - Insufficient evidence

name: CLAIM_SERVICE_STATUS_TYPE
description: This minor entity translates the claim service status type code into a description.  Examples: - Paid - Rejected - Under adjudication

name: CLAIM_SERVICE_TEXT
description: This entity contains any textual information related to a service performed for this claim.

name: CLAIM_SERVICE_TEXT_SECTION
description: This entity is the link to claim service text unstructured data.

name: CLAIM_STATUS
description: This entity tracks the history of the status of a claim.

name: CLAIM_STATUS_REASON_TYPE
description: This minor entity translates the claim status reason type code into a description.  Examples: - Insufficient coverage - Insufficient evidence

name: CLAIM_STATUS_TYPE
description: This minor entity translates the claim status type code into a description.  Examples: - Paid - Rejected - Under adjudication - Closed without payment - Reopened

description: This entity classifies the text such as report by adjustor, or agent notes.

description: This entity associates a claim authorization to the claims it is for. A claim can be associated to many claim authorizations and a claim authorization can be used for many claims.

name: CLAIM_TYPE
description: This minor entity categorizes the type of claim or claim service by line of business such as property and casualty, health, or life.

name: CLAIM_VISION_CONDITION

description: This is a case that is set up to research a claim. If the case is for the entire claim and not specific to a coverage then the coverage will be null.

description: This is a subtype to HEALTH CLAIM and describes those claims that are related to pharmaceutical needs.
